units.translation: I was ordered to speak by a wise teacher
among goddesses seen by gods
By whom were you persuaded?
it has been struck by male craftsmen
and deprived by whom?
what I, a god, suffer at the hands of the gods
what sufferings I must endure at the hands of Hera
the griefs we suffered at the hands of our parents
having suffered such terrible things at the hands of those dearest to her
by whom he is driven out of power
by whom he should not have been driven from the throne
children who died as if at the hands of their own kin
a noble man to die, and that at the hands of a woman
he perished by his hand
by whom he destroyed the life of a woman
he fell at our hands, he died
how can I be blameless in your eyes?
by a younger woman than I — to be cast out dishonored
where someone is about to win tears from the hearers
for if they should obtain from the gods what they desire
to bind this villain to high, steep rocks
to bind a god by force in a stormy ravine
nail him to the rocks
to waste away on lofty rocks
they dwell by the springs of the sun
there is a city of the Nile at its very mouth and bank
words strike at random against the waves of hateful ruin
having stumbled upon this misfortune
of a ship wearied by the sea wave
he roars at the Proetid gates
I will tell of the one who drew the lot at the gates
willingly to have fallen at the gates
whoever assigned this task to the shield
for fear now boasts at the gates
stationed at the gates
the seventh, this one, at the seventh gates
toward the setting of the lord Sun's rays
for such will be the blood-dripping offering at the land of Plataea
toil for the hungry at the feasts which the city provides
for the beds of the enemy were by the walls
for Thracian blasts dashed the ships against each other
the heart does not vainly seethe, whirled in eddies of fulfillment by just thoughts
Justice sharpens her blade for another deed of harm on other whetstones, Fate
the race is welded to ruin
the breast, at which you often slumbering drew rich milk with your gums
ready
he was driven
slain
my
let us dedicate to the house
of Erechtheus
of the games
you may throw
entwined
besides these, I gave them fire
in addition to what you have, you want to take more
and besides these, show me the end of my wandering
third in lineage, with ten other generations
and besides these, pray for better things
and what else besides these?
such a misfortune is yours to lament in addition to the former one
lest some evil be added to evils
for may good be added to good
and write these things in addition to the many other wise precepts already written
it stands toward the western regions
toward the rising of the sun, turning yourself
toward the flaming, sun-trodden east
bright, it seems, blowing toward the sunrise, he will bring
and this is Aegina, lying toward the south wind
wandering, ruin settles now on one, now on another
having traversed the end of a long journey to you
